BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Mexico Telecom Partners, legally Mexico Tower Partners, S.A.P.I. de C.V., is a neutral Mexican digital-infrastructure platform that owns and operates towers, rooftop sites, distributed antenna systems, small cells, edge facilities and data-center infrastructure. The platform serves major wireless operators and colocation users across Mexico. It was formed in May 2014 by combining Digital Bridge and Macquarie Mexican Infrastructure Fund portfolios. A June 2026 BMV filing reported approximately 3,737 sites and confirmed an unchanged 50/50 ownership split: DigitalBridge through MTP Mexico Holding B.V., and Macquarie Asset Management through MMIT I and MMIT II. The 2022 Macquarie-side transfer was internal, InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no signed or closed direct platform sale was identified through August 19, 2026.

api.description: Switch, Inc. develops, owns and operates large-scale U.S. data-center campuses serving AI, cloud and enterprise customers. The platform was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, with campuses in Nevada, Texas, Michigan and Georgia and a Pennsylvania expansion announced in 2026. DigitalBridge Partners II and IFM Global Infrastructure Fund completed the take-private on December 6, 2022. The latest comparable ownership schedule reports DigitalBridge at 55.8%, IFM at 37.2% and the management rollover group at 7.0%. Aware Super is also a current co-investor, but its exact stake, vehicle, closing date and nesting are not publicly disclosed and are not additive to that schedule. InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no later signed or closed direct Switch transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

api.ownershipVehicle: EQT Active Core Infrastructure SCSp / Small Cells HoldCo Inc.
api.description: Arium Networks LLC is a U.S. small-cell, distributed-antenna-system and venue-network infrastructure platform created from Crown Castle's former Small Cell business. It designs, deploys and manages outdoor and in-building wireless networks for the three largest U.S. mobile network operators and venue customers. EQT Active Core Infrastructure I announced the acquisition in March 2025 and completed it through Small Cells HoldCo Inc. on May 1, 2026, when Arium launched as a standalone company. Arium reported more than 100,000 small cells on air or under contract across 43 states at launch and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. EQT continues to list Arium as current. The separately sold Crown Castle Fiber Solutions business now owned by Zayo is outside this company boundary. Public sources do not disclose one comparable EQT economic stake across the nested fund and co-investment structure, and no later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.

Arium Networks LLC is a U.S. small-cell, distributed-antenna-system and venue-network infrastructure platform created from Crown Castle's former Small Cell business. It designs, deploys and manages outdoor and in-building wireless networks for the three largest U.S. mobile network operators and venue customers. EQT Active Core Infrastructure I announced the acquisition in March 2025 and completed it through Small Cells HoldCo Inc. on May 1, 2026, when Arium launched as a standalone company. Arium reported more than 100,000 small cells on air or under contract across 43 states at launch and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. EQT continues to list Arium as current. The separately sold Crown Castle Fiber Solutions business now owned by Zayo is outside this company boundary. Public sources do not disclose one comparable EQT economic stake across the nested fund and co-investment structure, and no later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
